title: Three injured, 30 evacuated after fire breaks out in Jalan Bukit Merah HDB flat, Singapore News

 singapore Three injured, 30 evacuated after fire breaks out in Jalan Bukit Merah HDB flat
 Fire involved contents of two cooking pots in the kitchen A fire broke out in the kitchen of a third floor unit at Block 105 Jalan Bukit Merah on Thursday (Nov 19) night. PHOTO: Social media PUBLISHED ON November 20, 2026 8:17 PM BY Sean Ler Around 30 people were evacuated and three persons taken to the hospital after a fire broke out in a HDB flat at Jalan Bukit Merah on Thursday night (Nov 19).
 A livestream hosted on TikTok showed firefighters and police officers responding to the incident at Block 105 Jalan Bukit Merah. At least two Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) firefighting appliances were seen in the video.
 In response to media queries, SCDF said it was alerted to the incident at about 8.15pm.
 Preliminary investigations indicated that the fire was caused by unattended cooking. The fire involved the contents of two cooking pots in the kitchen of a third floor unit and had burned itself out before firefighters arrived.
 The three persons taken to Singapore General Hospital were assessed for smoke inhalation. SCDF added that about 30 people were evacuated from the block as a safety precaution.
 According to the lifesaving force's 2025 data, 1,051 of the 2,050 cases of fires were at residential premises.
 Of these, fires due to unattended cooking and electrical origin remained the top two causes of fires at residential premises.
